$comment: The Wildlife photography collection. Files are Anya's final selection in public/assets/wildlife-photography/ and are served exactly as supplied (never resized, re-encoded or cropped). The folder a photograph sits in sets its visual weight: main-gallery → larger placements, secondary-gallery → smaller ones; the page never names these groups. `hero` opens the page; `homepage` is also the homepage's preview. `rows` is the viewing sequence: each row's photographs share one height and keep their own proportions. Titles follow the supplied filenames; captions are factual. After adding or replacing a file, run `node scripts/build-wildlife-photos.mjs` (it only reads the files: dimensions and a loading colour).

lion-on-the-road.title: Lion
lion-on-the-road.caption: Walking away down a dirt road.
lion-on-the-road.alt: A young lion walking away down a dusty dirt road lined with bare trees, under a hazy pink sky.

jacana.title: Jacana
jacana.caption: Walking across lily pads.
jacana.alt: A chestnut-bodied wading bird with long toes walking across lily pads, reflected in dark blue water.

golden-hour-lion.title: Golden hour lion
golden-hour-lion.caption: Resting in long grass.
golden-hour-lion.alt: A male lion with a pale mane lying in tall golden grass, looking towards the camera.

elephant-among-trees.title: Elephant among trees
elephant-among-trees.caption: Reaching up into the branches.
elephant-among-trees.alt: An elephant seen from below, its trunk stretched straight up into the leaves of a tree, tusks showing.

collared-cheetah.title: Collared cheetah
collared-cheetah.caption: Sitting beside a sandy track.
collared-cheetah.alt: A cheetah wearing a tracking collar, sitting upright in dry grass at the edge of a sandy track.

walking-leopard.title: Walking leopard
walking-leopard.caption: Crossing open ground.
walking-leopard.alt: A leopard walking across open, bare ground in front of a tangle of dry bushes.

sunset-giraffes.title: Sunset giraffes
sunset-giraffes.caption: Silhouetted against an orange sky.
sunset-giraffes.alt: Two giraffes in black silhouette between dark trees, against an orange sky.

african-fish-eagle.title: African fish eagle
african-fish-eagle.caption: Perched on a bare branch.
african-fish-eagle.alt: An African fish eagle, white head and dark body, perched on a curving bare branch against a pale pink sky.

twilight-hippos.title: Twilight hippos
twilight-hippos.caption: Heads just above the water.
twilight-hippos.alt: Two hippos with only their heads above still water that reflects a pink and purple sky, a dark treeline behind.

hornbill.title: Hornbill
hornbill.caption: Among sunlit branches.
hornbill.alt: A hornbill with a large curved yellow bill perched among sunlit branches and leaves against a blue sky.

perched-raptor.title: Perched raptor
perched-raptor.caption: At the top of a dead branch.
perched-raptor.alt: A brown bird of prey perched at the top of a bare, dead branch against a clear blue sky.

feeding-giraffe.title: Feeding giraffe
feeding-giraffe.caption: Reaching over a thorny bush.
feeding-giraffe.alt: A giraffe's head and neck reaching over the top of a thorny bush to feed, against a blue sky.

elephant-family.title: Elephant family
elephant-family.caption: Adults with young beneath them.
elephant-family.alt: Adult elephants standing together in dry bush, with young elephants sheltering in the shade beneath them.

elephant-profile.title: Elephant profile
elephant-profile.caption: Head and tusk, side-on.
elephant-profile.alt: A close, upright view of an elephant's head, ear and long tusk against green bush.
